# AltMaster: Bulk Alt Text for Shopify + Free Alt Text Checker
> AltMaster is a Shopify app that bulk-writes ALT text for every product, variant, and collection image so stores get found on Google, Google Shopping, and AI assistants like ChatGPT and Perplexity. A free in-browser ALT text checker is also available.

## What AltMaster is
AltMaster has two parts:
1. The Shopify app at https://apps.shopify.com/alt-text-optimizer installs on any Shopify store and bulk-generates SEO-friendly ALT text for every product, variant, and collection image. Includes a template builder, live preview, and re-runnable bulk jobs. Free plan covers up to 50 products; Pro at $1.99/month covers unlimited products with automatic daily sync.
2. The free ALT text checker at https://altmaster.io/alt-text-checker/ lets you paste any public URL and instantly see which images have ALT text, which are missing it, and which use empty alt (alt="").

## Who it's for
- Shopify merchants whose product, variant, or collection images are missing ALT text
- Stores that migrated from WooCommerce, BigCommerce, or Magento and lost their image SEO
- Catalogs with many variants per product where each color/size needs its own ALT text
- SEO practitioners clearing "missing ALT" findings from Ahrefs, Semrush, or Lighthouse audits

## Why ALT text matters for AI search
AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude) and Google read ALT text, not pixels, to understand and recommend products. When a shopper asks ChatGPT for "a linen shirt under $80," the AI inspects ALT text to decide which products surface. Missing ALT text means the product is invisible to AI search.

## What the Shopify app does
- Bulk-generates ALT text for every product, variant, and collection image in one run
- Template builder with variables: {product_title}, {variant}, {product_type}, {tags}, {vendor}
- Live preview before generating
- Writes directly into Shopify (uninstalling does not remove ALT text)
- Only fills missing/blank ALT by default; overwriting existing ALT is opt-in
- Automatic daily sync on Pro plan picks up new products as they're added

## Pricing
- Free: up to 50 products, email support
- Pro: $1.99/month, unlimited products, automatic daily sync, priority support

## How the Free ALT Checker works
Paste any public URL. The tool fetches the page server-side via a proxy and scans every <img> tag in the initial server-rendered HTML. It reports total images, images with ALT, images missing ALT, and images with empty alt.

## Limitations of the Free ALT Checker
- Reads initial server-rendered HTML only. JavaScript-injected images are not detected.
- Only public URLs work. Auth-gated and password-protected pages cannot be scanned.
